descriptor.scene: Three friends arrive: MAYA, CHRISSY and the ENGINEER walk away from the camera along the rim garden terrace of the island, exactly the terrace the locked plate paints: pale stone underfoot, the low rim rail on the right with open sky and the green sea of jungle far below, terraced gardens and low cream buildings rising on the left, a brass wind-spire against the warm sky. They are seen from BEHIND at mid-distance, heads and bodies pointed the same way, walking into their arrival; Maya's laptop is under her left arm even here. Coming the other way, two anonymous residents pause to welcome them, each holding a small folded hand-drawn map, marks visible as soft pencil lines only. The picture is warm, quiet and slightly smaller than a myth. Keep the lower right calm: rail and sky.
descriptor._caption: Founder Heaven is smaller than the myths and kinder than the smudged advice. And nearly everyone who stands there arrived the same way: holding a map a friend drew.
descriptor.anonymous: two anonymous resident founders pausing to welcome the arrivals, each holding a small folded hand-drawn map with unreadable pencil marks
